notes.note: Second fix-round delta (#2494 slice 1, same PR): a workspace Codex start, resume or adoption fork that Station sends no mode to now asks Codex for sandbox workspace-write at thread level with approvalPolicy unset, so an operator config of never plus danger-full-access runs confined instead of being refused; only a Codex that still reports wider is refused. A record where nothing was engaged now names no mechanism (host/no-mechanism, refused if required). Breadth refusals list the writable roots outside the workspace and the fix (remove them, or run as a host session). A comment pins that the refusal precedes session.started. Added one sentence that a workspace session with no Station mode sends only sandbox workspace-write and no approvalPolicy; checked against codex-adapter.ts approvalWire and forkNativeAdoption. The approvalsReviewer claims are unchanged.
